posts.text:
Missouri favorites for a good day out. 🗺️

Mark Twain's boyhood home in Hannibal, the Nelson-Atkins in Kansas City, the castle ruins at Ha Ha Tonka and Gardens Aglow in Springfield.

posts.theme: Place: Gardens Aglow, Springfield
posts.text:
📍 Gardens Aglow, Springfield

More than 225,000 holiday lights glowing in the Japanese garden, fire pits, and something warm to drink. 🎄

The paths are paved, lit and level, with benches along the way, so it is an easy evening out for Mom or Dad. It runs late November through December.

A Show-Me Neighbor can drive, walk alongside and keep them company. More good days out in Greene County:
{LINK}

posts.theme: Place: Christmas Traditions, St. Charles
posts.text:
📍 Christmas Traditions on Historic Main Street, St. Charles

Carolers, costumed Christmas characters and Santa parades fill the old brick street. 🎶

It is free, on Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays from November 27 to December 24. Bundle up and enjoy the show.

A Show-Me Neighbor can drive, walk alongside and keep Mom or Dad company. More good days out in St. Charles County:
{LINK}

posts.theme: Place: Wonders of Wildlife, Springfield
posts.text:
📍 Wonders of Wildlife, Springfield

Giant aquarium windows and wildlife galleries, right next to Bass Pro Shops. 🐟

It has elevators throughout and seating in the galleries, which makes it a great indoor day out when the weather will not cooperate. Ask about their local discounts.

A Show-Me Neighbor can drive, walk alongside and keep Mom or Dad company. More good days out in Greene County:
{LINK}

posts.theme: Place: The Keeter Center, Point Lookout
posts.text:
📍 The Keeter Center at College of the Ozarks, Point Lookout

A special meal in a grand log lodge, cooked and served by College of the Ozarks students. 🍽️

Reservations are a good idea, so plan ahead and make it a treat for Mom's birthday or just a Tuesday.

A Show-Me Neighbor can drive, sit down to lunch with her and bring her home again. More good days out around Branson:
{LINK}

posts.theme: Place: Northview Center, Springfield
posts.text:
📍 Northview Center, Springfield

Bingo, choir, dance lessons, crafts, billiards and good company for adults 55 and older. 🎲

SeniorAge serves lunch there on weekdays, so it is a great place to make a few new friends over a hot meal.

A Show-Me Neighbor can drive Mom or Dad there, stay a while and bring them home. More good days out in Greene County:
{LINK}

posts.text:
📍 Lewis and Clark Boat House and Nature Center, St. Charles

Full-size replica boats from the Lewis and Clark expedition, plus exhibits about the river and its wildlife. 🛶

A great pick for a dad or grandpa who loves history, right on the riverfront.

A Show-Me Neighbor can drive, walk alongside and keep him company. More good days out in St. Charles County:

A peaceful morning out for anyone who loves the lake.

posts.theme: Place: Katy Trail, St. Charles
posts.text:
📍 Katy Trail State Park, St. Charles

A flat, easy stretch of the famous rail-trail along the Missouri River, just a block from Historic Main Street. 🍂

It is free, and it is a lovely place for a slow walk and some fresh air.

More than 500 animals from five continents, a giraffe feeding deck, a petting zoo and the Titus Express miniature train. 🦒

Perfect for a day with Grandpa, and maybe the grandkids too.

The main path is level, with benches along the way, so it is an easy, lovely outing. The garden is open April through October.
